Configure current feature

  1. Enable/build GAS dependencies. Add one ASC to ARPGPlayerState, one to ARPGEnemyCharacter; initialize owner/avatar actor info on possession and replicated readiness.
  2. Replace the movement fixture’s resource adapter with ASC stamina. Define replicated health/mana/stamina and damage/effect rules; remove duplicate resource variables.
  3. Place BP_CombatProbe in L_NetworkLab. Assign DA_Ability_Vanguard_Cleave and Ranger projectile example, DA_CombatRules_Default, targeting and action-bar assets. The probe has100health and no AI/rewards.

Only place actors whose systems are active in this phase; later rows are staged expansion instructions, not a requirement to build all map content now. Keep placeholders labeled and preserve earlier test sections.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Connect A and B. A soft-selects the probe, attacks within range and LOS, then attacks from behind the blocking wall.
  2. Use a projectile and a radius heal/damage fixture; server resolves allowed targets, mitigation and accepted health deltas once per action.
  3. Interrupt a cast, overdraw stamina/mana and attempt cooldown replay; inspect prediction correction and owner attribute UI.
  4. Remove/skip PaperZD notifies and presentation, then repeat damage and cooldown expiry.
Expected success
Health changes only on server-approved hits/effects; action-bar resources converge to ASC state.
Prediction rejection removes predicted cost/cues appropriately; missed animation notify cannot duplicate damage or hold the gameplay action forever.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Enemy pathfinding, defeat/XP and recovery enter08. Production casting art is absent/unverified; magic placeholders must be labeled.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureDead/out-of-range/blocked target and invalid ability ID reject. One melee action cannot hit the same target twice unless its definition explicitly permits ticks.
current-phase fixtureMissing visual sequence is cosmetic failure, not permission to bypass cooldown or grant a hit.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Accepted attacks apply once without animation notifies and correct predicted UI on rejection.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
